notes:
TWO SILHOUETTES: 19 (x 106-414, y 110-392) is the head/upper body and 13 (x 148-372, y 370-516) is the lower body block, drawn BEFORE 19 so its top edge is hidden behind it. Both are BODY. No path is drawn twice — there is no stroke-only outline overlay in this drawing; every outline comes from the stroke on the filled path itself.

EYEBROWS: 35 and 36 are dark-purple (#5E30B0) crescents at y 116-166, sitting on the top arcs of the eyeballs (25: cx 196 cy 200 r 46, top at y 154; 26: cx 320 cy 196 r 40, top at y 156). They are eyebrows, so they are EYES, not silhouette shading — but their colour is a darker version of the body colour, so when the game repaints the monster these two must follow the main colour, even though they live in the eyes part.

ARMS ARE POSED DIFFERENTLY (not mirrored): the screen-left arm 0 sweeps DOWN and out (152,374 to 80,428) and its hand 41 (x 44-112, y 426-514) points its three claws downwards; the screen-right arm 1 sweeps UP and out (356,376 to 444,334) and its hand 42 (x 424-501, y 256-357) points its claws upwards. So arm 1/42 cannot be produced by mirroring arm 0/41 — it is raised, like a wave. Note also that hand 42 (y 256-357) reaches as high as the mouth, well above the legs, so height alone does not tell arms from legs here.

LEGS: 2 and 3 are the same rounded-rect foot drawing repeated, 3 shifted right and 4px down (2 centred at 181,542; the mirror of 181 about the canvas centre x=260 would be 339, and 3 is centred at 341). Strictly they are TRANSLATED copies, not mirrored: the toe strokes 4/5 (left) and 6/7 (right) all lean the same way instead of being handed. Treated as symmetric because the two legs are the same drawing.

STROKE-ONLY SHAPES: 4, 5, 6, 7 (toe lines) and 11 (antenna stalk) have fill "none" — they exist only as navy strokes, so a repaint must not try to fill them. 11 plus the ball 12 form the single antenna; 8/9 are the two cream horns and 10 is the pale highlight inside the screen-left horn only (the right horn has no highlight).

NAVY SERVES TWO JOBS: #0B1B3B is both the outline stroke everywhere and the FILL of the pupils 29 and 30, so it is listed once, as ink, with the pupils in usedBy.

PURPLE FAMILY: main #9B5DE5 (silhouettes, arms, hands), two darker shades — #7A43C9 for the feet and the under-belly shadow 14, and the darker #5E30B0 for the eyebrows — and lighter tints #B584F0 (top-of-head sheen 20 and the four spots 15,16,21,22), #F3E7FF (pale belly 17) and #FCF6FF (the highlight streak 18 on the belly). All six should be derived from the monster's colour when repainting. Fixed colours that must never change: navy #0B1B3B, white #FFFFFF, teal iris #21C1AC, pink cheeks #FF85B3, mouth cavity #E85E93, tongue #FF9BC0, tooth cream #FFFDF5, and the horn/antenna accents #FFE3A3, #FFF3D6, #FFC145.
